Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 1, 2001; provided, the amended provisions of Article 30(3), Article 30-2, Article 32, and Article 69-2 shall enter into force on January 1, 2002.
Article 2 (General transitional measures on occurrence of causes for benefits)
With respect to benefits for a person for whom the cause for benefits has occurred before this Decree enters into force, the previous provisions shall apply.
Article 3 (Transitional measures concerning calculation of monthly salary for teachers and staff subject to the annual salary system)
The monthly salary for 2001, calculated pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 3-2(1), for teachers and staff subject to the annual salary system who are in service at the time this Decree enters into force, shall be the amount obtained by multiplying the monthly salary amount for 2000 by the average rate of increase in remuneration of public officials.
Article 4 (Transitional measures concerning conversion of monthly remuneration into present value)
Where the monthly remuneration for periods of service or military service aggregated pursuant to Article 32(1) of the Act on or after January 1, 2001 is converted into present value pursuant to Article 35(4) of the Act and Article 3-3 of this Decree, the average rate of increase in remuneration of public officials applicable to periods of service or military service before this Decree enters into force shall, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 3-3, be 6 percent per annum.
Article 5 (Transitional measures concerning payment method of aggregation refund)
(1) The method of payment of aggregation refunds for teachers and staff who obtained aggregation of periods of service pursuant to Article 32(2) of the Act before this Decree enters into force shall, notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 19 (2), be governed by the previous provisions.
(2) For a person who obtained aggregation of periods of service before this Decree enters into force and is paying in installments pursuant to Article 19(2), the interest rate applicable to the installment payment period after this Decree enters into force shall be determined pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 20(3). In such cases, the interest rate shall be recalculated based on the highest fixed deposit interest rate applied by nationwide banks as of January 1 of the year in which this Decree enters into force.
Article 6 (Transitional measures concerning recovery of benefits)
(1) With respect to the calculation period of interest to be added to benefits and delinquency interest to be added to recovery amounts for which a disposition for recovery of benefits has been made pursuant to Article 39 of the Act before this Decree enters into force, the previous provisions shall apply notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 25(1).
(2) With respect to recovery of benefits for which a disposition for recovery of benefits has been made pursuant to Article 39(2) and (3) of the Act before this Decree enters into force, the previous provisions shall apply notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 25(4).
Article 7 (Transitional measures concerning payment of contributions based on monthly remuneration before reduction)
With respect to a person who, at the time this Decree enters into force, is paying contributions based on the class and salary step before reduction pursuant to the proviso of the former Article 35(2) of the Act, the amended provisions of Article 22-3 shall apply; and the monthly remuneration for the year in which this Decree enters into force based on the class and salary step before reduction shall be deemed to be the monthly remuneration before reduction under Article 22-3.
Article 8 (Transitional measures concerning calculation of refund for persons who obtained re-aggregation after exclusion from aggregation)
Where a person who, at the time this Decree enters into force, has been excluded from aggregation due to delinquency in payment of refunds for part or all of the period of service aggregated pursuant to Article 32(4) of the Act, and subsequently obtains aggregation of periods of service after this Decree enters into force pursuant to Article 5 of the Addenda to Act No. 6330, the refund to be paid shall be newly calculated as the amount that was required to be refunded at the time of delinquency plus delinquency interest under Article 20(4) for the period during which refunds were delinquent before cancellation (deemed to be 6 months where such period exceeds 6 months), and such amount shall be paid.
Article 9 (Transitional measures concerning calculation of benefit amounts)
Where, pursuant to Article 6 of the Addenda to Act No. 6330, a person is promoted, demoted, transferred, reassigned, or reappointed (meaning a case where a retired teacher or staff member, public official, or soldier is appointed as a teacher or staff member and obtains aggregation of periods of service or military service pursuant to Article 32(1) of the Act; hereafter the same shall apply in this Article) before December 31, 2000 and retires or dies within one year thereafter, the monthly remuneration before such promotion, demotion, transfer, reassignment, or reappointment shall be the amount obtained by multiplying such monthly remuneration by the average rate of increase in remuneration of public officials pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 3-3.

periods of service)
Calculation of contributions for retroactively aggregated periods of service to be paid pursuant to Article 4(4) of the Addenda to the Act shall be as follows:
(Monthly remuneration of the month in which the day preceding the enforcement date of the Act falls) × average rate of increase in remuneration of public officials × contribution rate under the previous provisions × (6.3 ÷ 5.525)
Article 10 (Transitional measures concerning conversion of monthly remuneration or average monthly remuneration of previous periods into present value)
(1) For teachers and staff who are in service as of January 1, 2010, the amount obtained by converting the monthly remuneration or average monthly remuneration under Article 4(7)1 of the Addenda to the Act into present value as of the time to which the date of occurrence of benefits belongs shall be calculated in accordance with the following formula: <Amended on April 29, 2014>
(Monthly remuneration or average monthly remuneration as of the day preceding January 1, 2010) × [(average standard income monthly amount of all public officials for the month in which the date of occurrence of benefits falls) ÷ (average standard income monthly amount of all public officials for taxable income in 2008)]
(2) Where a person appointed as a teacher or staff member after January 1, 2010 obtains aggregation of previous periods, the monthly remuneration or average monthly remuneration under Article 4(7)1 of the Addenda to the Act shall be calculated in accordance with the following formula: <Amended on April 29, 2014>
(Amount obtained by converting the monthly remuneration or average monthly remuneration at the time of previous retirement into present value as of the time of appointment as a teacher or staff member by applying the average rate of increase in remuneration of public officials) × [(average standard income monthly amount of all public officials for the month in which the date of occurrence of benefits falls) ÷ (average standard income monthly amount of all public officials at the time of appointment as a teacher or staff member)]
(3) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), where the amount calculated under paragraph (1) is less than the amount obtained by sequentially multiplying the monthly remuneration or average monthly remuneration as of the day preceding January 1, 2010 by the average rate of increase in remuneration of public officials for each applicable period to convert it into present value as of the date of occurrence of benefits, the latter amount shall be the monthly remuneration or average monthly remuneration of the previous period. <Amended on April 29, 2014>
(4) Notwithstanding paragraph (2), where the amount calculated under paragraph (2) is less than the amount obtained by converting the monthly remuneration or average monthly remuneration at the time of previous retirement into present value as of the time of appointment as a teacher or staff member by applying the average rate of increase in remuneration of public officials and then sequentially multiplying by the average rate of increase in remuneration of public officials for each applicable period to convert it into present value as of the date of occurrence of benefits, the latter amount shall be the monthly remuneration or average monthly remuneration of the previous period.
(5) Where the monthly remuneration or average monthly remuneration of previous periods is converted into present value as of the time to which the date of occurrence of benefits belongs pursuant to paragraphs (1) and (2), and the cause for long-term benefits occurs before the application of the standard income monthly amount for the relevant year based on the previous year's income (meaning from January to June of the relevant year), the amount under paragraphs (1) and (2) shall be deemed to be the amount reflecting the average rate of increase in remuneration of public officials for that year. <Added on April 29, 2014>
Article 11 (Transitional measures concerning determination of standard income monthly amount)
(1) Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 3-2(4), the standard income monthly amount of a leave-of-absence holder or reinstated person whose period of income-earning activity in the year preceding the enforcement of this Decree is less than one month shall be determined pursuant to the amended provisions of Article 3-2(3).
(2) Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 3-2(5) 1, the standard income monthly amount of a person in service who has no income data at the time this Decree enters into force shall be determined by the TP as the amount corresponding to the median of the standard income monthly amount of teachers and staff in the same or similar type and position at the same grade in a school institution.
(3) A teacher or staff member who intends, pursuant to Article 2(2) of the Addenda to the Act, to apply the monthly remuneration of the month in which the day preceding the enforcement date of this Act falls as the standard income monthly amount shall submit an application stating the previous monthly remuneration to the head of the affiliated school institution, and the head of the affiliated school institution shall forward such application to the TP within 7 days. In such cases, where the head of the affiliated school institution is the head of a school, the application shall be forwarded to the TP in a manner indicating consent of the head of the relevant school management body.
Article 12 (Transitional measures concerning application of delinquency interest rates)
(1) Notwithstanding the proviso of Article 25(1) 2 and the amended provisions of Article 72-2(1), calculation of delinquency interest on recovery amounts and contributions for periods prior to the enforcement date of this Decree shall be governed by the previous provisions.
(2) Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 72-2(2), matters concerning delinquent amounts corresponding to periods prior to the enforcement date of this Decree shall be governed by the previous provisions.
Article 13 (Transitional measures concerning change in scope of delegated work)
Notwithstanding the amended provisions of Article 30-2, with respect to work delegated to the National Health Insurance Service at the time this Decree enters into force, the previous provisions shall apply until the delegation contract for such work is terminated or renewed.
